text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: Dear Mom and Dad, Listen to this! Today, I went to a fancy cafe with my trainer and City! The City! My idol!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: I can't tell you how many magazines I've bought with Gold City on the cover. She's got the looks, the street smarts, and the biggest heart!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: And she's a hard worker to boot! I'm gonna put my nose to the grindstone and become a cool and confident city girl, just like her!
